name: Sidelying Clamshell
description: lie on your side with your knees bent and feet together. Keeping your feet touching, slowly lift your top knee while keeping your pelvis stable and avoiding rotation of your trunk. Lower your knee back to the starting position with control and repeat. This exercise helps improve hip stability, pelvic control, and lower-extremity strength.
